name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.42.0: a warning when a fridge cannot take cards. Fridge v0.58.0+ reports its Nayax link state to POST /api/v1/machines/:code/payment-status on every change and every 5 minutes. Down for PAYLINK_DOWN_MIN minutes (default 10, timed on the server clock) raises one critical payment_link_down alert per machine and emails the AG admins (or OPS_ALERT_EMAIL); the first report of up resolves it and emails again. A once-a-minute sweep catches a link that goes down and stays down. Cumulative over v6.41.0.
